BUDGET.falsification_requirement: State a concrete observation that refutes the hypothesis; retain all fact, source, replay and statistical gates.
BUDGET.scope: Investigate independent budget hypotheses; nonseed overhead does not prove waste.

DEDUP.falsification_requirement: State a concrete observation that refutes the hypothesis; retain all fact, source, replay and statistical gates.
DEDUP.scope: Investigate independent deduplication hypotheses; duplicate appearance does not prove dispensability.

DEPENDENCY.falsification_requirement: State a concrete observation that refutes the hypothesis; retain all fact, source, replay and statistical gates.
DEPENDENCY.scope: Investigate independent cross-member dependency and conservative fallback hypotheses.

GENERALIST.falsification_requirement: State a concrete observation that refutes the hypothesis; retain all fact, source, replay and statistical gates.
GENERALIST.scope: Independently choose a falsifiable hypothesis within the frozen selection seam.
